root_idea.summary: A large, hard stone: a rock or mass of rock.
root_idea.development: The lexical field distinguishes an individual rock, صَخْرَة, from صَخْر as rocks or great masses; the Quranic forms retain this concrete stone sense.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular citation form صَخْرَة.
Displayed under the normalized noun صَخْر, denoting rocks or great masses of stone.

senses.definition: An individual rock or mass of hard stone.
senses.usage_conditions: In contrast with the collective or mass term صَخْر, this form denotes one rock. A classical interpretation of its Quranic use describes the rock as lying beneath the ground.

senses.definition: Rocks or great masses of hard stone.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a collective or plural designation for substantial solid rocks, distinct from the individual-rock noun صَخْرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place abounding in rocks or great masses of hard stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct place-denoting lexical use, not the ordinary material noun for rock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sound of iron striking iron.
A kind of earthen vessel used for drinking.
A hard-faced person; one with little shame.
